title: Checkout Session removes shipping details
summary: Within a Checkout Session, the shipping_details top-level field has moved to the collected_information.shipping_details field. This change breaks compatibility because we’re removing the shipping_details field to the collected_information sub-hash on the same Checkout Session resource. Update your integration to reflect the new field name.
migrationNotes: This change affects how you access shipping information on the Checkout Session resource: it improves how the API resource is organized, grouping related information more logically. By moving shipping details into the collected_information object, it becomes clearer that the customer provided this information as part of the checkout process.
1. Review your code that interacts with the Checkout Session resource.
2. Identify any instances where you’re accessing the shipping_details field.
3. Update these instances to use collected_information['shipping_details'] instead.

sources.quote: | [Checkout Session removes shipping details](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/basil/2025-03-31/checkout-session-remove-shipping-details.md) | Checkout | Breaking | api |

This change breaks compatibility because we’re removing the `shipping_details` field to the [collected_information](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/object.md?api-version=2025-03-31.basil#checkout_session_object-collected_information-shipping_details) sub-hash on the same Checkout Session resource. Update your integration to reflect the new field name.
